Carrot cake is a moist, spiced cake made with grated carrots, cinnamon, and nutmeg.
The batter often includes walnuts or raisins for added texture.
A classic carrot cake recipe calls for a rich cream cheese frosting that complements
the earthy sweetness of the carrots. Carrot cake remains one of the most popular
baked desserts, beloved for its tender crumb and warm spice flavour.
